title: A draft expense: in the reference system it has a draft number, no journal and no effect on the treasury until it is issued, and issuing it posts the journal; this application has no draft expense

draft_expense.note: A draft expense saved with Save as draft has a number of the form Draft-N, no journal and no effect on the treasury; Issue gives it the next real number and posts the journal; Convert to draft on an issued expense deletes its journal

cases.reason: An expense here is either posted or deleted; there is no draft state. No package owns drafts of expenses: WP14, the draft and quote lifecycle of sales, is the nearest and would have to be widened to cover them.
